blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marikina local government said it is eyeing to further expand its leather goods industry in time for the Christmas season as it kicked off its annual shoe bazaar on Friday. Known as the Shoe Capital of the country, the Marikina commenced its Christmas Shoe Bazaar, this time with the intent of further promoting the city’s craftsmanship, particularly in the production of bags, wallets, belts and other leather products. “The initiative aims to showcase the diversity of Marikeño craftsmanship and provide more opportunities for local manufacturers and artisans to promote their products,” Marikina Mayor Marjorie Ann “Maan” Teodoro […]...
